visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde braided hair, wearing a red Adidas crop top and black baggy pants, stands outdoors in a park-like urban setting with green bushes. She holds a violin and a bow, gesturing energetically towards the camera. (2) The camera cuts to a medium shot of the creator interacting with a young female participant in a white lace dress. The participant holds a microphone while the creator stands ready with her violin. (3) An animated graphic of a song title '惡魔之子' by Ai Higuchi appears over a blurred background. (4) The creator plays the violin vigorously while the female participant sings into the microphone. They are surrounded by urban greenery and a low stone wall. A yellow graphic '挑戰成功!' (Challenge Success!) appears. (5) The creator is now with a young man in a green knit vest and glasses. He holds a microphone as she plays the violin for him. (6) A graphic for 'Oshi no Ko' appears, followed by another song title 'Idol' by Yoasobi. (7) The creator plays the violin in a wide shot while the man in the green vest watches. Passers-by are visible in the background. (8) The scene shifts to the creator interacting with a young man with dreadlocks carrying a plastic bag. She plays the violin while he listens and eventually reacts with a smile. (9) A final song title graphic '不再聯絡' by 379 appears on the screen. (10) The creator wraps up the video by talking to the camera and the man with dreadlocks, laughing and waving in the same urban park setting.
